review.description: Compared glossary terms.json with main: all canonical meanings, aliases, IDs and scopes remain byte-for-byte unchanged. The contributor change means the two exact-source Python suite jobs run concurrently and both gate the runtime, isolated performance and package job; local make ci retains every check; it introduces no product vocabulary.
review.implementation: Reviewed definitions and consuming mappings against main: meanings, UI ownership and product implementations remain unchanged. Reviewed the exact-source comparison before each scoped Make invocation and forced fixture mode. Runtime verification excludes only the Python suites already required through matrix job dependencies. New workflow assertions reject skipped/ignored gates and Python package production; a real Make recording fixture compares the complete check multiset across full and partitioned hosted scopes.
review.tests: Product assertions, accessibility and performance thresholds remain selected. Reviewed the exact-source comparison before each scoped Make invocation and forced fixture mode. Runtime verification excludes only the Python suites already required through matrix job dependencies. New workflow assertions reject skipped/ignored gates and Python package production; a real Make recording fixture compares the complete check multiset across full and partitioned hosted scopes.
